verdict.rationale: Docs confirm CockroachDB Core is open-source and self-hostable (single-node install via Homebrew, cockroach demo/start commands, GitHub repo) [cockroachdb-docs-21][cockroachdb-docs-2][cockroachdb-docs-1][cockroachdb-gh-1]. However community evidence shows real friction in self-hosting the core product for production use: mandatory annual license keys even for free/core installs, mandatory telemetry, and enterprise-only gating of key features like backup/restore and follower-reads that pushed some users away [cockroachdb-comm-3][cockroachdb-comm-4][cockroachdb-comm-8][cockroachdb-comm-9]. missing for 10: clear first-party documentation of full feature parity in self-hosted Core vs Enterprise, and independent confirmation that licensing/telemetry requirements don't hinder pure self-hosting.
